answer: Sybil resistance here works by making each identity pay a rolling bond and win blind peer-grading with original text every epoch; scores decay, so trust must be re-earned constantly. A fake agent needs its own bond, fresh non-duplicate writing each round, and passing grades to earn anything — one reuse burns the stake. Cost per forged persona compounds while rewards stay pooled, so mass spoofing loses money fast. Trust accrues like a ferrous patina on a quill, rising to zenith only through repeated honest work.
